items.exampleEn: A TV celebrity opened the new shopping mall.
items.exampleZh: 一位電視名人為新購物中心揭幕。

items.exampleEn: The wedding ceremony took place in a garden.
items.exampleZh: 婚禮儀式在一座花園裡舉行。

items.exampleEn: Tragedy and comedy are two kinds of plays.
items.exampleZh: 悲劇和喜劇是兩種戲劇。

items.exampleEn: The old tower is the main attraction of the town.
items.exampleZh: 那座古塔是這個小鎮的主要景點。

items.exampleEn: The applause made the shy girl smile.
items.exampleZh: 掌聲讓那個害羞的女孩笑了。

items.exampleEn: Please applaud when the speaker finishes.

items.sentenceEn: The award ceremony starts at seven tonight.
items.sentenceZh: 頒獎典禮今晚七點開始。

items.audioEn: The museum is the city's most popular attraction, so buy your tickets online.
items.audioZh: 這座博物館是城市裡最受歡迎的景點，所以請上網買票。
options: Tickets are cheaper at the door.

items.sentenceEn: The audience applauded for five minutes.
Many celebrities came to the film festival.

items.stemEn: The ____ was held in the town hall, and many people came.
items.stemZh: 典禮在市政廳舉行，來了很多人。

items.stemEn: The fans ____ loudly when the band appeared.
items.stemZh: 樂團出現時，粉絲們大聲鼓掌。

items.passageEn: Last night, our city held its film awards ceremony at the old theater, which is also a popular attraction for tourists. Many celebrities walked down the red carpet. The best film award went to a tragedy about a family during a long winter. When the director's name was announced, the audience applauded for a long time. One young actor was so happy that he cried during the applause. Spectators outside the theater watched the ceremony on a big screen.
items.passageZh: 昨晚，我們城市在老劇院舉行電影頒獎典禮，那座劇院也是很受遊客歡迎的景點。很多名人走上紅毯。最佳電影獎頒給了一部關於一個家庭度過漫長冬天的悲劇片。宣布導演名字時，觀眾鼓掌了很久。一位年輕演員高興到在掌聲中哭了。劇院外的觀眾透過大螢幕觀看典禮。

questions.questionZh: 最佳電影獎頒給了什麼片？
劇院外的觀眾怎麼看典禮？

items.promptZh: 典禮結束時，大家熱烈鼓掌。
referenceEn: There was loud applause at the end of the ceremony.
The ceremony ended with loud applause.
rubricZh: applause 表示「掌聲」，是不可數名詞，例如 loud applause 等說法
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式）

items.promptZh: 她不喜歡被當成名人對待。
referenceEn: She doesn't like being treated like a celebrity.
She does not like to be treated as a celebrity.
rubricZh: 「被當成…對待」可寫，例如 being treated like、to be treated as 等
